exposure: Indication for induction of labor (12 groups)
Gestational age at birth (38-39 weeks vs. 40 weeks or later)
cohort: 3330 nulliparous women with singleton, cephalic presenting pregnancies, induced at 38-39 weeks gestation, planning a vaginal birth
finding: Rates of vaginal birth after induction of labor at 38-39 weeks gestation varied widely depending on the indication for induction, ranging from 54% for suspected large fetus to 82% for suspected fetal compromise.
mod_finding: This study found that rates of vaginal birth following induction of labor at 38 or 39 weeks gestation vary widely according to the indication for induction.
